prompts.prompt: For Sentinel playbooks built on Azure Logic Apps, what is the default timeout for a single action, and what is the maximum duration for an entire workflow? Answer concisely with both time values.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sentinel-playbooks/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls: default timeout is 30 seconds per action, 90 days per workflow

prompts.prompt: What request rate limit does the VirusTotal free tier API impose, which Sentinel playbook designers need to account for with throttling? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sentinel-playbooks/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls: Rate limiting - VirusTotal free tier: 4 req/min

prompts.prompt: Sentinel playbooks can be started by three different trigger types. Name all three. Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/sentinel-playbooks/SKILL.md - Playbook Trigger Types table: Incident trigger, Alert trigger, Entity trigger
